content.text:
AI Executive Order Asks Companies for Early Model Access
On Tuesday the White House issued an executive order establishing a voluntary process for artificial-intelligence models to be assessed for cybersecurity threats. President Donald Trump had delayed the release of the order two weeks ago amid concerns that it was too stringent.
